title: The Briefing
tagline: AI intelligence for Gauntlet AI — May 8, 2026

items.headline: CopilotKit: Generative UI for React Agents
items.summary: Build agents that render charts, forms, and interactive UIs on demand. Integrate LangChain agents with React frontends using the AG-UI protocol. Taught by Atai Barkai, CopilotKit's CEO.

items.headline: AI Prompting for Everyone
items.summary: Learn practical prompting techniques to get more useful results from AI tools. Course by Andrew Ng covering web search, deep research modes, brainstorming partnerships, and no-code app building.

items.headline: MCP Apps for Agent Integration
items.summary: Use Model Context Protocol (MCP) apps to connect agents to external tools and data sources. Support for canvas-style interactions where agents and users work with shared state.

items.headline: Short Courses Week at DeepLearning.AI
items.summary: New batch of short, focused courses on practical AI topics including prompting, agent development, and UI generation for AI applications.
